tools.name: todays_board
tools.description: The games on CrystlQuant's board today and tomorrow, in start order: each matchup, its start time and CrystlQuant's pick, with a link to each game's page. The board carries no chances; each game's CrystlQuant chance, the market's chance and the gap are on the game's page.

tools.name: biggest_gaps
tools.description: The three upcoming games where CrystlQuant and the market disagree most, biggest gap first, including games where they back different winners. Each row links to the game's page; every other disagreement is on crystlquant.com (the link comes with the answer).

tools.name: find_game
tools.description: CrystlQuant's pick and win chance for one upcoming game (today or tomorrow), found by a team or fighter name, for example 'Chiefs', 'Arsenal' or 'Pereira', with a link to the game's page, where the market's chance and the gap are.

tools.name: who_wins_it_all
tools.description: Title chances: each league's likeliest champions from CrystlQuant's season forecasts, with the change since the last update and a link to the league's page. A row with no CrystlQuant number yet shows the Blind model's chance and says so. The limit is per league.

tools.name: rankings
tools.description: CrystlQuant's team ratings for the NFL, NBA, MLB or NHL, or its UFC rankings by division and pound for pound, with movement since the last update. The limit is per list (each UFC division is its own list).
